{{Article header|deck=A surface-mined gemstone cargo with buyers in tourism, high-tech, and industrial economies.}}
{{Commodity infobox|ruby}}

'''Ruby''' is a gemstone cargo commodity introduced with the [[Rhino]] update. Its description combines decorative uses in jewellery and fashion with practical uses in manufacturing devices, where its hardness is valuable.<ref name="ruby-inara">[https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/10501/ Ruby — Commodity], INARA.</ref><ref name="rhino-update">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-1-0 Elite Dangerous — 4.4.1.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments.</ref> For a commander, it is a surface-mining target and trade cargo, rather than a loose raw material stored in the [[Engineering Materials]] inventory.

== Finding and extracting Ruby ==

{{Commodity acquisition|ruby}}

INARA lists Ruby's production as '''surface mining'''.<ref name="ruby-inara" /> Plan around a [[Rhino]] expedition: carry it in a compatible ship's [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar]] and bring a [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] to find '''Planetary Mining Locations'''. The Rhino then uses its own scanner to locate buried deposits on the ground.<ref name="rhino-store">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/store/product/rhino-standard Rhino Standard], Frontier Developments.</ref><ref name="rhino-update" /><ref name="rhino-devlog">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments.</ref>

'''Ruby's body-class distribution has not been verified.''' Treat a mining location as a place to search, not a guaranteed gemstone deposit, and check the resource information at the deposit before deploying a rig. There is no verified body-class shortcut for choosing a Ruby destination.

The Rhino deploys mining rigs at suitable deposits and has an onboard refinery. Applying that general surface-mining workflow to Ruby gives the refining route in the table above; it is not a measured Ruby-specific yield or processing rate.<ref name="rhino-store" /><ref name="rhino-devlog" /> [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]] covers the practical rig-placement, recovery, and cargo-handling procedure.

== Planning a sale ==

{{Commodity uses|ruby}}

Tourism, High Tech, and Industrial economies are listed as consumers.<ref name="ruby-inara" /> Use the current [https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/10501/ Ruby market listings] to compare buyers before hauling your cargo: demand, travel distance, docking access, and the age of a report all matter more than a single advertised price.

If you intend to buy Ruby rather than mine it, look for an offer with positive supply. Normal NPC stock has not been established, and a buy-price entry with zero supply does not provide cargo to collect. Refined Ruby occupies cargo storage, so leave room for it when planning the return from a surface-mining trip.
